title: AI Vision and OCR Tools
summary: This module provides tools for performing Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and general image analysis using large language models. It supports processing images from both local files and URLs.

nodes.label: Input Image (Path/URL)
nodes.title: Image Input
nodes.description: Represents the source of an image, which can be a local file path or a remote URL, provided to the vision or OCR tools.

nodes.label: Perform Optical Character Recognition
nodes.title: OCR Tool
nodes.description: The OCRTool component extracts text from images using an underlying LLM. It handles both local files (via base64 encoding) and direct URLs.

nodes.label: Analyze Image Content
nodes.title: Vision Tool
nodes.description: The VisionTool component analyzes images to describe their contents, leveraging vision-capable LLMs like OpenAI's Vision API. It supports local files and URLs.

nodes.label: Encode Local Image to Base64
nodes.title: Image Base64 Encoder
nodes.description: A utility function responsible for reading local image files and encoding them into a base64 string format suitable for LLM API calls.

nodes.label: Local File System
nodes.title: File System Access
nodes.description: Represents the local file system from which image files are read for processing by the tools.

nodes.label: LLM Vision API Service
nodes.title: Vision LLM
nodes.description: An external Large Language Model service (e.g., OpenAI Vision API) that performs the actual OCR and image content analysis based on provided image data.

nodes.label: Extracted Text Output
nodes.title: OCR Result
nodes.description: The textual output generated by the OCRTool after processing an image, containing recognized characters and words.

nodes.label: Image Description Output
nodes.title: Vision Description
nodes.description: A descriptive text output generated by the VisionTool, detailing the contents and characteristics of the analyzed image.

groups.label: Surface Tools
groups.title: User-Facing AI Tools
groups.description: These are the primary tools exposed by the module for direct use, providing OCR and general image analysis capabilities.

groups.label: Data Handling
groups.title: Image Data Processing
groups.description: Components involved in preparing and managing image data for AI processing, including input, encoding, and output.

groups.label: AI Backend
groups.title: Core AI Processing
groups.description: The external AI service responsible for performing the complex vision and OCR tasks.
